flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/ then For every product card on the page, read its name and its stock or scarcity message (for example "Only 3 left" or "12 in stock"). Store them all as one text in the form "name: message | name: message" as stock_1.
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/ again so the page fully loads fresh, read every product card again the same way, and store the list as stock_2.
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/ once more and store the list as stock_3.
Read each list from the page after its own fresh load; do not copy an earlier value.
Do not add anything to the cart.
If there are no stock messages, @v16:"store \"none\" for all three".
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.

remark: analyze: there are no stock messages
wait: PRIMARY: wait for the fresh homepage product cards to load
analyze: ANALYZE(textual_visual, 'the product-card name and stock or scarcity messages ar
wait: PRIMARY: wait for the final fresh homepage product cards to load
analyze: ANALYZE(textual_visual, 'the product-card name and stock or scarcity messages ar
wait: Waiting briefly after all stock lists are stored and verified

summary:
Reviewed every product card’s availability message on the initial page load: AirWave Pro Earbuds had 4 left, PulseFit Smartwatch had 3 left, Glow Desk Lamp had 2 left, and Trail Backpack 30L had 3 left.
Reloaded the homepage and reviewed the cards again: AirWave Pro Earbuds had 3 left, PulseFit Smartwatch had 4 left, Glow Desk Lamp had 3 left, and Trail Backpack 30L had 4 left.
Reloaded the homepage a third time and reviewed the cards again: AirWave Pro Earbuds had 2 left, PulseFit Smartwatch had 3 left, Glow Desk Lamp had 5 left, and Trail Backpack 30L had 5 left.
Completed the availability review without adding any products to the cart or entering payment information.
